This plot is very small, just a small piece near the house, and I have farmed it for many years the way my father showed me. I have no money for the fertilizer from the shop, and on Pemba here most of us do not buy it anyway — I will put the goat droppings and kitchen ash I collect through the year, that is what keeps this soil alive. The seed I keep from last harvest, it is what grows well on this sandy ground, and I have no pump or pipe so the rain must do its work. I and my wife will do all the work ourselves on such a small piece, there is no need to call anyone to help.
